strain: S. cerevisiae strain co-expressing Lcb1, Lcb2, Tsc3, Orm1, and Sac1

To unravel the architecture of the yeast SPOTS complex, we generated a S. cerevisiae strain co-expressing Lcb1, Lcb2, Tsc3, Orm1, and Sac1 (Sup. Fig. 1a) under the control of the inducible GAL1 promoter.
